rationale: Do not restore or cherry-pick the archived branch. Develop has a later, tenant-scoped growth implementation with code-owned safe actions, append-only review lineage, live cutoff-bound source reads, and explicit UTC fixtures. The archived nightly snapshot job and demo-only settings seeds would duplicate those contracts and can make recommendations stale. The unrelated archived loyalty summary and receipt display additions are explicitly retired below; current wallet lookup and checkout redemption do not implement them.

commits.rationale: The archived receipt loyalty balance, wallet value, earned points, earn rate, and getLoyaltySummary helper are absent from develop and are intentionally not restored by issue #475. The archived helper reads the live points ledger and currently effective program when a receipt is requested, so later wallet activity or program changes can change wallet figures on reprints. Restoring that display requires a separate decision about settlement snapshots and reprint semantics. Existing wallet lookup, loyalty accrual, and checkout redemption remain implemented; they are not evidence of receipt display parity.
